sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for the Japanese companion app Mochi Days. Input image is an identity and plush-material reference only; create a NEW sheet and preserve the original. Soft 3D plush illustration, warm gentle studio light, delicate fur, simple seamless flat pale-ivory background (#fff8ee), no text, labels, borders, watermarks or extra animals. Exact square canvas, evenly divide into FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal square cells, 16 independent full-body sprites. Every sprite must fit wholly inside its own cell with 10% empty space on all sides, the same head size, center, scale and baseline; no accessories touching neighbors. In each consecutive pair, left is seated with eyes open and a warm smile, right is joyful with eyes smiling closed and both paws/flippers raised. The character keeps its face and species across all costumes. Do not merge cells. Subject: the same fluffy ivory-white baby puppy, round head, floppy ears, dark glossy button eyes, pink cheeks and paw pads. Row-major cell pairs: cells 1 and 2: a tiny honeybee costume with striped sweater and antenna headband; cells 3 and 4: pastel butterfly wings and flower bow; cells 5 and 6: a strawberry bonnet and strawberry sweater; cells 7 and 8: a lemon bonnet and yellow scarf; cells 9 and 10: a cherry hair bow and pink capelet; cells 11 and 12: a sunflower bonnet and green overalls; cells 13 and 14: a hydrangea flower bonnet and lavender capelet; cells 15 and 16: a mushroom beret and woodland vest. Exactly 8 different costumes, two poses per costume.
